summary: CCC Intelligent Solutions filed an 8-K disclosing a definitive merger agreement entered October 14, 2026 with Mozart Parent, LLC and Merger Sub, under which Merger Sub merges into CCC with CCC surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary. Each outstanding share converts into $7.75 cash per share, without interest. The board unanimously approved and recommends stockholders adopt the agreement. Options are cashed out at the spread over the $7.75 price. This is a take-private transaction; watch the proxy timeline, appraisal rights, financing conditions and any competing superior proposal risk-arb.
